record.summary: Creates, within the national transparency and data-protection authority, a programme to promote analysis, regulation and state capacity-building for the development and use of AI in the public and private sectors while guaranteeing rights to transparency and personal-data protection. It has three components: an AI observatory (mapping actors, tracking regional and global regulation, periodic reports); governance and participation (a multidisciplinary advisory council and participatory drafting of regulatory strategies against rights violations and harmful AI impacts); and capacity-building (good-practice guides, training, awareness campaigns, and documentation of automated decision systems).
record.notes: Signed on 30 Aug 2023 and published in the Boletín Oficial on 4 Sep 2023 (no. 35247, p. 17). The AAIP's national directorates for transparency policy evaluation and for personal data protection carry out the programme jointly and set up mechanisms to monitor and evaluate it (Art. 2). The annex also provides for publishing the transparency criteria of automated decision systems on the National Transparency Portal. The recitals cite the OECD AI Principles, the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI and the Recommendations for a Trustworthy AI approved by Disposición 2/2023 (AR-01). The resolution sets no date of entry into force.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored and read: the original text of Resolución 161/2023 with its annex on Argentina's official legal database (argentina.gob.ar, copy of 11 Oct 2026), which gives the number RESOL-2023-161-APN-AAIP, the issuing agency, the signature (30/08/2023), the publication in the Boletín Oficial (04-09-2023, no. 35247, p. 17), Articles 1-3 and the programme's objectives, components and lines of action. The page lists the norms the resolution complements ('Modifica o complementa estas 3 normas') and no norm that modifies or repeals it. Version 1's remark that Argentina has no AI-specific statute and that numerous bills are pending rests on no stored file and was removed from the notes. No English translation by an Argentine public body was found; law-firm summaries in English are not translations.

judgment.status_reasoning: Signed on 30 Aug 2023 and published in the Boletín Oficial on 4 Sep 2023. It creates a programme (Art. 1) and instructs two of the agency's directorates to carry it out (Art. 2); it imposes no duties on the public, so it is non-binding. The official database page (copy of 11 Oct 2026) lists only the norms the resolution complements and no norm that modifies or repeals it. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands; date_in_force stays null because the text has no entry-into-force clause.
judgment.scope_reasoning: An AI-specific programme of Argentina's data-protection and access-to-information authority (a horizontal supervisory authority); in scope with no note.
